fullContentHtml:
RRB NTPC 10+2 UG CBT-II Answer Key 2026 – Full Details

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the CBT-II Answer Key for the Non Technical Popular Categories NTPC 10+2 Under Graduate Level Post on the official website of RRB after evaluating candidates’ performance in the examination. This recruitment was conducted for 3058 posts. Applications for the RRB NTPC 10+2 UG Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 28 October 2025, to 04 December 2025. The CBT-II examination was held on 17 September 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their RRB NTPC 10+2 UG CBT-II Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 28 October 2025
  • Last Date : 04 December 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 December 2025
  • Correction / Modified Form : 07 December 2025 to 16 December 2025
  • Application Status : 06 February 2026
  • Exam Date : 7, 8, 9 May & 13, 14, 15, 16, 20 June 2026
  • Exam City Details : 10 Days Before Exam
  • Admit Card : 04 Days Before Before Exam
  • Answer Key : 27 June 2026
  • Result : 24 August 2026
  • Score Card : 26 August 2026
  • CBT II Exam Date : 17 September 2026
  • CBT-II Exam City Details : 07 September 2026
  • CBT-II Admit Card : 13 September 2026
  • CBT-II Answer Key : 23 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 400/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
